notation: prospectus-v2: L1 cover document title (PROSPECTUS); fund name on cover and title-page issuer block are text. L2 front sections (IMPORTANT INFORMATION, CONTENTS, DEFINITIONS, ADMINISTRATION INFORMATION, FUND INFORMATION...); L3 subsections and per-fund sections. Directory labels (CHAIRMAN:, DIRECTORS:, ...) and run-in labels (Asset Class, Investment Policy) are text.
